name: Guizhou Broadcasting & TV Information Network Co., Ltd.
summary: Guizhou BC&TV Information Network CO.,LTD operates and constructs radio and television network in China. The company is involved in cable TV network construction; and broadband network, smart radio, radio and television 5G, and cultural tourism and technology business businesses. It also provides cable TV program live audio-visual, program content landing transmission, network installation and daily management and maintenance, radio and television audio-visual, and program content transmission services. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Guiyang, China.
